verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a Test environment that 'replicates the full functionality of the Live environment' and lets you 'simulate real-time transactions'. It explicitly names simulated authorizations and refunds, and collaborative authorization lets your own logic approve or decline transactions in real time. However, clearings, reversals and declines are never explicitly shown as simulatable lifecycle events in the sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox simulation of clearings/settlement, reversals, and network-initiated declines, plus documentation of the simulation API itself and independent or hands-on corroboration.
